task.title: PHASE B2 — SAVE YOUR TASK
task.objective: Extend the accepted B1 in-memory task capture flow with a small versioned browser-local workspace using localStorage, load the saved task list on the next page load, and disclose the Beginner storage behavior under approved DR-005 before any task is persisted.

If implementation requires a separate storage adapter/component, shared state across modules, data migration, security/identity controls or another file, stop and reclassify/re-contract before editing.

format.workspaceId: One generated UUID string persisted in the workspace envelope; stable across all future saves.

storage.scope_note: Proposed runtime-persistence envelope for B2, derived from the Phase 3.2 Data Model's format identifier, formatVersion, sourceMode, workspaceId and data collections. It is intentionally not identical to the later export/backup JSON: fields such as exportedAt and timezone belong to the export/use-case specification and are not runtime fields for this bounded lesson. B2 persists only tasks and preserves the other canonical collections as empty. This runtime envelope must be treated as a Contract proposal subject to Owner approval, not as a pre-existing approved runtime schema.
storage.id_generation: Generate one workspaceId when a new workspace is first persisted, then reuse it for every subsequent write. Use crypto.randomUUID() if available in the actual GAIS Preview runtime. If unavailable, stop and report; do not introduce a package or insecure fallback.
validation: Require workspaceId to be a non-empty string.
Require data object with projects, tasks, checklistItems and appliedStarterKits arrays, and settings object.
Require each task to have a unique non-empty id and a non-empty trimmed title.
B2 only creates/reads task fields id and title; other canonical task fields are deferred until their lessons/contracts require them.
Do not silently clear, replace or overwrite malformed or unsupported stored content.
storage.initialization: If the key is missing, start with an empty in-memory task list and an unpersisted empty workspace. Do not write an empty default on mount. DR-005 acknowledgement is required before the first task write.
storage.write_order: Construct the complete next envelope in memory -> serialize -> call localStorage.setItem once for the single agreed key -> only after success commit the new React tasks state and clear the input/validation messages. If setItem throws, retain the prior React task list and title input, display a truthful error and do not claim the task was saved.
storage.load_order: On first client mount, read the localStorage key once and validate the canonical format identifier, formatVersion 1, workspaceId and data.tasks records. Do not write an initial empty state before load completes. If the key is absent, use an in-memory empty task list as an unsaved new workspace; DR-005 notice must be acknowledged before the first persisted task.
storage.atomicity_note: localStorage.setItem is atomic for a single key from the application's perspective; use one versioned workspace key and never split a task across multiple keys.
storage.quota_and_access_errors: Catch storage exceptions (including quota/security/unavailable storage errors), show a plain-language message, preserve the current data and entered title, and allow the user to retry. Do not silently fall back to sessionStorage or memory while displaying a saved-success state.
storage.cross_tab: Cross-tab synchronization is out of scope. No BroadcastChannel or storage-event synchronization is required.

acknowledgement.exact_copy:
Where your tasks are stored

In Beginner mode, your tasks are stored in this browser on this device. They do not automatically sync to other browsers or devices.

Clearing this site's browser data may delete your tasks.

Browser storage is not a separate backup. You will learn to export a JSON backup in a later lesson.

Do not enter passwords, API keys, or sensitive information in this learning app.
acknowledgement.state: Component memory only for the current page session. No separate localStorage/cookie/sessionStorage acknowledgement key in this Contract.
acknowledgement.fresh_session: When the page is opened in a fresh session, require acknowledgement before the first persisted task.
acknowledgement.existing_workspace: If a valid workspace already exists after reload, show the disclosure non-blockingly as a readable notice/control so normal task entry is not repeatedly blocked.

storage.workspace_id_creation: Generate one workspaceId when a new workspace is first persisted and keep it for all subsequent writes. Reuse a secure UUID function available in the runtime; if crypto.randomUUID is unavailable, stop and ask for review rather than invent a weak ID generation method.
formatValidation: workspaceId is a non-empty UUID generated once and stable across writes.
data is an object and data.tasks is an array.
projects, checklistItems and appliedStarterKits are arrays; settings is an object; they remain empty in this B2 lesson.
Each task has a unique non-empty id and a non-empty trimmed title.
Malformed JSON, unknown version or invalid task data must not be auto-cleared or overwritten.
storage.read_failure: If the key does not exist, initialize an empty in-memory workspace and wait for acknowledgement before first persist. If it exists but is malformed/unsupported, preserve it untouched, disable writes, and show a clear recovery message; do not silently treat corruption as empty.
storage.write_failure: Construct the next full envelope and call localStorage.setItem once. Only after setItem succeeds may the new task appear in the committed React list and the input clear. If it fails, preserve previous tasks and input and show a truthful error. Never claim saved.
storage.load_failure: Malformed JSON, unsupported format/version or invalid records: preserve the exact current storage value; block writes; show a clear, accessible recovery message. Never silently clear, reset or overwrite corrupted data.
storage.workspace_id_rule: Generate a workspaceId once when the first task is successfully persisted. Preserve that identifier on later writes. Use crypto.randomUUID() if available in the actual GAIS Preview; otherwise stop and request review. Do not add a package or use a weak random identifier.
storage.export_boundary: No export/import functionality is implemented in B2. Do not add exportedAt, file download, file picker, validation preview, merge/replace or restore flows. A later task must adopt the complete backup envelope defined in Data Model §7 and its own Contract.
storage.data_preservation: Existing valid workspace data is loaded before writes. Every write serializes a complete next workspace snapshot to the same key. Invalid data or a storage exception must never cause the prior value to be silently cleared or replaced.

behavior: Preserve the B1 title-only input, Add task, trimmed titles, exact empty input validation, task insertion order, empty state, semantic label and Enter submission.
On initial load, display any valid tasks stored under the workspace key.
Before the first valid task is persisted in a new workspace/session, display the DR-005 inline disclosure; the Add task interaction must not persist a task before acknowledgement.
When the learner acknowledges, enable task entry; acknowledgment alone must not write a workspace or claim a backup exists.
When a valid task is submitted, attempt to persist the next workspace. Show it as saved only after localStorage.setItem succeeds.
When a stored workspace exists, subsequent tasks update the same versioned workspace and maintain insertion order.
On refresh, previously saved tasks are reloaded from the same app origin and browser profile.
No automatic cross-device sync is provided.
No export/import, restore, cloud backup or account sign-in is included.
ux_constraints: Preserve current B1 UI layout and component structure as much as practical.
Use the Phase 3.1 design package as the design authority; do not redesign the app.
DR-005 appears as a concise inline notice at the top of the current workspace, not a blocking modal or full-screen onboarding flow.
Use current typography, spacing, surfaces, border and responsive behavior already present. Do not invent new global color tokens.
At phone width, the notice must wrap naturally without horizontal scrolling and the task input/Add task remain usable.
Provide accessible heading, text, action, focus state and clear success/error status.
Do not claim settings navigation exists; More -> Settings & Backup remains a future full-product location until implemented.
out_of_scope: Projects, checklists, notes, priority, due dates, task status, editing, deletion and completion.
More navigation and Settings & Backup page implementation.
Supabase, PostgreSQL, Auth, RLS, Firebase, API, external service, cloud sync.
New packages, lockfiles, config, global styles, layout, routes or any file other than app/page.tsx.

constraints: Read BVC Task Management Project Instructions and all required approved sources listed in this Contract.
Inspect the actual app/page.tsx before editing; compare it with the Owner-supplied B1 source.
Modify exactly one file: app/page.tsx. Do not create, modify, rename, move or delete another file.
Use the existing framework and packages only; no dependency, lockfile, configuration, layout, CSS, route, API or external service changes.
Use browser localStorage only, under the exact workspace key in this Contract.
Use the proposed versioned runtime workspace envelope in this Contract. Do not present it as the full backup/export schema.
Display the exact approved DR-005 Beginner disclosure inline before the first persisted task; use the approved action label.
Keep acknowledgement only in component memory during the current page session; do not write a separate acknowledgement key.
On page load, read and validate stored data before enabling writes. Do not initialize by writing an empty workspace.
If storage is missing, start with an in-memory empty workspace. If the stored content is malformed or unsupported, preserve it unchanged, block writes and show a truthful message.
On task submission, build the next full workspace, write it once to localStorage, and only after success commit React state and clear the input.
If the storage write fails, preserve prior tasks and input and show an error; never claim the task was saved.
Preserve all B1 behaviors: trim, exact empty-title message, successful input clearing, insertion order, Enter submission, label association and empty state.
Do not add projects, checklist, notes, priority, due date, status, edit/delete/complete, backup/export/import/restore, Settings, More navigation, cross-tab sync, cloud sync, account or database.
Match the existing Phase 3.1 UX baseline: compact inline notice, no modal/full-screen onboarding, accessible and responsive.
Report exact changed files and distinguish checks actually run from NOT_RUN/NOT_VERIFIED. Do not claim unperformed build, lint, E2E or storage-failure tests passed.

risk.rationale: The Contract limits changes to one existing page component/file and does not alter database schema, authentication, authorization, security controls, architecture baseline or external infrastructure. Persistence integrity is controlled with validation, non-destructive error handling and Owner-reviewed evidence. Reclassify if scope crosses into shared adapters/components or a protected technical domain.
risk.reclassification: If implementation crosses the single component boundary into multiple components/shared state flows, reclassify R3 and issue a revised Contract; protected identity/security/database domains require R4 review.
